entries.text: Hi, it's Sarah from HeliumDeploy. Thanks for taking a few minutes with me: your code, 15% off the BSB Bitaxe Gamma 602 (1.8TH/s) on orders of $100+, shows up on screen as soon as we finish. I see you were looking at the Bugatti Gatsby Carry-On. What caught your eye?
It's for a two week trip to Portugal with my wife in November. We fly Air Transat.
Two weeks in Portugal in November sounds lovely. Air Transat's carry-on limits are worth checking, so size probably matters. What matters most to you when choosing a carry-on?
Mostly it has to fit the carry on size limit. And be light. I really hate heavy bags.
Heavy bags are no fun, especially when you're hauling one through airports. Which other stores or brands are you comparing this carry-on with?
I looked at Sam's tonight on Amazon and something at Costco. But the Bugatti looks nicer.
Nice, so looks are tipping it toward the Bugatti. Is anything holding you back from buying it, like price, shipping time, or not being sure it's the right size?
Honestly, I just want to know the exact dimensions. And if shipping is fast enough before the trip,
I don't have the exact dimensions or delivery times, and I won't guess. The product page and shipping policy have them, and I'll point to the dimensions. How did you find HeliumDeploy?

Take a look at that section for the measurements, and the shipping policy page covers delivery timing, so you can check it before November. I'm curious, though: how did you find HeliumDeploy in the first place?
I an Instagram ad a few days ago. That's how I found you.

Thanks, an Instagram ad a few days ago, good to know. Just so you know, your code is for the BSB Bitaxe Gamma 602 on orders of $100 or more, so it won't cover the carry-on. Thank you for your time. Press "End call" and your code will appear on screen. Enjoy Portugal, goodbye!
While you're still here, one more thing. If the dimensions on the page fit Air Transat's limit, would that settle it for you?
